messages:
Meera: quick sync 9pushed an iter for the rollout timeline and a compact 'last action' undo modal in Figma: https://figma.com/file/efgh5678 (frames: 'Timeline Compact v3', 'LastAction Undo')

Alex: looked through. main UX ask: the timeline currently shows versions in a single column with timestamps; its noisy. what if we split into two lanes: Active (top) and History (bottom), with history grouped by day? that should surface running canaries without adding a filter.

Sasha: accessibility checklist: lane headings need role="region" and aria-label. timeline items must have meaningful accessible names (version, percent, status). for keyboard, each item needs a focus ring and an affordance to open the slider panel. also, if we reorder (active -> top), announce with aria-live="polite" and include a short phrase like 'Now showing active deployments first'.

Jon: copy tweaks: replace terse verbs. 'Promote' -> 'Promote to production'; 'Rollback' -> 'Roll back to prior stable'; action confirmation should show a 1-line summary 'This will route X% traffic to vY (est. latency delta: +Zms)'. keeps SRE and support informed. also include the commit hash short (e.g., abc123).

Pat: undo behavior proposal: immediate toast with 'Undo' for 25s, and keep a reversible 'Last action' card pinned in the timeline for up to 3 minutes. only allow undo for the last mutation to avoid complexity. animation: subtle pulse on the card while undo is possible, but respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Devin: small perf note: if we auto-promote active canaries to top, avoid re-rendering the whole list on each health ping. debounce reorder to 1s and only reposition when status flips (starting/stopped). this keeps screen readers happier too (less chatter).

Sasha: contrast note: the 'Active' pill currently uses #ffd54f on white, contrast < 3:1. propose #e0a800 or add 1px stroke + drop shadow. also provide a non-color indicator: append visually-hidden '(active)' and show a dot icon for sighted users.

Alex: sorting control decision: prefer auto-sort (Active lanes first) + a small overflow menu 'Sort & filters' for users who need older-first. default remains simple.

Meera: decisions recap: two-lane layout (Active / History), auto-sort active-first with menu override, aria-live polite announcements for reorder, focusable items with explicit accessible names, copy changes to longer-form verbs and confirmation summary including traffic + short commit id, undo: 25s toast + 3m last-action card, debounce reorder 1s, contrast fix to darker amber + non-color marker, respect reduced-motion. I'll update Figma and share frames.

Jon: one nuance: in confirmation modal let's show an optional 'View impact details' link that expands to historical metrics for similar rollouts (latency, errors). helps PMs and SEs decide.

Meera: agreed. I'll add that link as a collapsible details panel. Alex/Sasha/Pat please review updated frames by EOD tomorrow. thanks! :tada:
